templates.pattern: Light travels at 3 × 10⁸ m/s in a vacuum. How far does light travel in [T] seconds?
A ray of light hits a plane mirror at an angle of incidence of [A] degrees. What is the angle of reflection?
templates.explanation: Law of reflection: angle of incidence = angle of reflection. Both measured from the normal. Answer = [RESULT] degrees.

templates.pattern:
Light travels from air into glass and slows down. The angle of incidence is [A] degrees. Which of the following correctly describes the angle of refraction?
A) It is larger than [A] degrees
B) It is smaller than [A] degrees
C) It is equal to [A] degrees
D) It is always 90 degrees
options: A) It is larger than the angle of incidence
B) It is smaller than the angle of incidence
C) It is equal to the angle of incidence
answer_label: B) It is smaller than the angle of incidence
B) It is smaller than the angle of incidence
B) It is smaller than the angle of incidence
B) It is smaller than the angle of incidence
B) It is smaller than the angle of incidence
B) It is smaller than the angle of incidence
B) It is smaller than the angle of incidence
templates.explanation: When light enters a denser medium (air → glass) it slows down and bends toward the normal. So the angle of refraction is always smaller than the angle of incidence.

templates.pattern: An object is placed [U] cm in front of a plane mirror. How far behind the mirror does the image appear?
templates.explanation: In a plane mirror the image appears as far behind the mirror as the object is in front. Image distance = [RESULT] cm.

templates.pattern:
A converging lens has focal length [F] cm. An object is placed [U] cm from the lens, where [U] is greater than [F]. Which statement about the image is correct?
A) The image is virtual and upright
B) The image is real and inverted
C) The image is real and upright
D) No image is formed
templates.explanation: When an object is placed beyond the focal point of a converging lens, the image formed is real and inverted. It can be projected onto a screen.

templates.pattern: Light takes approximately 8 minutes to travel from the Sun to Earth. The speed of light is 3 × 10⁸ m/s. What is the approximate distance from the Sun to Earth in metres?
A glass block has a refractive index of [N]. Light travels at 3 × 10⁸ m/s in a vacuum. What is the speed of light inside the glass block in m/s?
templates.explanation: Speed in medium = c ÷ n = 3×10⁸ ÷ [N] = [RESULT] m/s

templates.pattern: A concave mirror has a focal length of [F] cm. What is its radius of curvature in cm?
templates.explanation: Radius of curvature = 2 × focal length = 2 × [F] = [RESULT] cm

templates.pattern: A ray of light hits a surface at [A] degrees measured from the surface itself. What is the angle of incidence measured from the normal?
templates.explanation: Angles in optics are always measured from the normal. Angle from normal = 90° − angle from surface = 90 − [A] = [RESULT] degrees.

templates.pattern:
A magnifying glass (converging lens) of focal length [F] cm is used to view an object placed [U] cm from the lens. The object distance [U] cm is less than the focal length [F] cm. Which of the following correctly describes the image?
A) Real, inverted and diminished
B) Real, upright and magnified
C) Virtual, upright and magnified
D) Virtual, inverted and diminished
templates.explanation: When the object is inside the focal length of a converging lens, the image is virtual, upright and magnified. This is exactly how a magnifying glass works.
